test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Holitisc'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling and meaning for the word is** "Holistic."**
 
• **Holistic (adjective)**: Referring to the approach or belief that emphasizes the whole picture, considering all aspects or parts of something in an interconnected and comprehensive manner.

Therefore, the **correct answer **is: **'Holitisc'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation for the **other options:**

 
 
• **Roast**: A cooking method where food, typically meat, is cooked in an oven or over an open flame, usually at high temperatures.
 
• **Ghost:** The term "ghost" refers to the spirit or soul of a deceased person that is believed to appear or haunt a particular location.
 
• **Malt:** A substance made from germinated cereal grains, usually barley, that is dried and used in brewing and distilling processes.
